```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(mosaic) # Our all-in-one package
library(skimr) # Looking at data
library(janitor) # Clean the data
library(naniar) # Handle missing data
library(visdat) # Visualise missing data
library(tinytable) # Printing Static Tables for our data
library(DT) # Interactive Tables for our data
library(crosstable) # Multiple variable summaries
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(RColorBrewer)
```


```{r}
C <- read_csv("data/panel-C.csv")
```

```{r}
world <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")
glimpse(world)



world |> gf_sf(geometry = ~ geometry)


worldSelect <- world |> dplyr::select(name, geometry)
Cmod <- C |> left_join(worldSelect, by = c("country" = "name"))
Cmodded <- Cmod |> dplyr::mutate(country=as.factor(country), continent=as.factor(continent))

Cmodded |> gf_sf(geometry= ~ geometry, fill = ~ lifeExp) # the countries with higher life_exp are a lighter shade of blue, which gets darker as the life_exp gets lower
Cmodded |> gf_sf(geometry= ~ geometry, fill = ~ gdpPercap)# the countries with hiher gdp_percap are a lighter shade of blue, which gets darker as the gdp_percap gets lower)
Cmodded |> gf_sf(geometry= ~ geometry, fill = ~ pop) # the countries with hiher populaton are a lighter shade of blue, which gets darker as the population gets lower)



glimpse(Cmodded)
inspect(Cmodded)
skim(Cmodded)
```

```{r}
#INTERACTIVE MAPS WITH LEAFLET
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.providers) # Base Map tile providers
library(leaflet.extras) # leaflet frills and thrills

# Data
library(osmdata) # Import OSM Vector Data into R

# pak::pak("datadotworld/data.world-r")
#library(data.world) # For India Airports Data
```

```{r}
m <- leaflet() %>%
  # Add default OpenStreetMap map tiles
  addTiles() %>%
  # Set view to be roughly centred on Bangalore City
  setView(lng = 77.580643, lat = 12.972442, zoom = 12)

m
```

```{r}
library(leafsync) # For latticeView of all maps here
# 1. OpenStreetMap --------------------------------------------------------

map_osm <- leaflet() |>
  setView(lng = 77.5946, lat = 12.9716, zoom = 11) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = 77.5946,
    lat = 12.9716,
    radius = 4,
    color = "black",
    fillOpacity = 1,
    label = "Bangalore centre"
  )


# 2. Esri World Street Map ------------------------------------------------

map_esri_street <- leaflet() |>
  setView(lng = 77.5946, lat = 12.9716, zoom = 11) |>
  addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldStreetMap") |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = 77.5946,
    lat = 12.9716,
    radius = 4,
    color = "black",
    fillOpacity = 1,
    label = "Bangalore centre"
  )


# 3. Esri World Topographic Map -------------------------------------------

map_esri_topo <- leaflet() |>
  setView(lng = 77.5946, lat = 12.9716, zoom = 11) |>
  addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldTopoMap") |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = 77.5946,
    lat = 12.9716,
    radius = 4,
    color = "black",
    fillOpacity = 1,
    label = "Bangalore centre"
  )


# 4. Esri World Imagery ---------------------------------------------------

map_esri_imagery <- leaflet() |>
  setView(lng = 77.5946, lat = 12.9716, zoom = 11) |>
  addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldImagery") |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = 77.5946,
    lat = 12.9716,
    radius = 4,
    color = "black",
    fillOpacity = 1,
    label = "Bangalore centre"
  )


# 5. Esri Gray Canvas -----------------------------------------------------

map_esri_gray <- leaflet() |>
  setView(lng = 77.5946, lat = 12.9716, zoom = 11) |>
  addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldGrayCanvas") |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = 77.5946,
    lat = 12.9716,
    radius = 4,
    color = "black",
    fillOpacity = 1,
    label = "Bangalore centre"
  )


# 6. OpenTopoMap ----------------------------------------------------------

map_opentopo <- leaflet() |>
  setView(lng = 77.5946, lat = 12.9716, zoom = 11) |>
  addProviderTiles("OpenTopoMap") |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = 77.5946,
    lat = 12.9716,
    radius = 4,
    color = "black",
    fillOpacity = 1,
    label = "Bangalore centre"
  )


# Display as small facets --------------------------------------------------

latticeView(
  map_osm,
  map_esri_street,
  map_esri_topo,
  map_esri_imagery,
  map_esri_gray,
  map_opentopo,
  ncol = 3,
  sync = "all",
  sync.cursor = TRUE
)
```
